_about: THE CREW WAGE TABLE — a starting point for a fee, never a floor.
READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A NUMBER. There is no current union scale to
quote. The FEFSI–TFPC wage MoU signed in 2022 expired on 9 March 2025
and had not been replaced when the dispute reached the Madras High
Court, which sent it to mediation (rates.chennai.checks.json,
`hansindia-fefsi`; CLAUDE.md open item 7). No primary copy of the 2022
MoU's per-craft schedule was found, so the per-craft `bata` fields are
null on purpose: a figure typed here from memory would be shown to a
producer as though somebody had checked it.
The one figure in this file is `general`: the day pay the FEFSI
president described in a press interview after the March 2022 hike.
It is a quote about the agreement, not the agreement, and it is
EXPIRED. The page says both on every line that shows it.
The user overrides any row (bata, call hours, overtime rule) on the
budget page; overrides live in fms_costs_v1 under `wageOverrides`, keyed
by row `id`. Row ids are therefore storage keys — never rename one.
VERSIONED. A new agreement is a new `version` block, not an edit to
this one: `validFrom`, `validTo`, `source` and `status` describe the
agreement the rows came from. `status` is one of: expired, current,
draft. Nothing in the app may treat an `expired` table as current.
title: FEFSI–TFPC wage MoU, 2022
statusNote: Last published agreement (2022 MoU) — EXPIRED 9 March 2025, in Madras High Court mediation. No current union floor exists. Confirm every figure with your union before you budget it.

hansindia-fefsi.name: The Hans India — FEFSI moves Madras HC over underpayment to technicians
hansindia-fefsi.says: The 2022 MoU expired on 9 March 2025; FEFSI's case was that technicians in the state often earn less than ₹3,000 a day.

dtnext-reel-big-fight.name: DT Next — Reel big fight: Producers vs Union workers
dtnext-reel-big-fight.says: Day pay was ₹850; FEFSI members were given a ₹450 hike in March 2022, making it ₹1,300 a day for the three years of the agreement.
dtnext-reel-big-fight.caveat: A union leader's account in an interview, not the agreement's schedule, and the article was not re-read when this table was written (2026-10-07). Treat it as reported, not verified.

general.craft: FEFSI member — general daily bata (as reported)
general.note: One figure for a member's day, quoted by the union's president; the MoU's per-craft grades were not published with it.

rules.note: The 2022 MoU's call-time and overtime clauses were not found published. Set the ones your unit agreed on each row — call hours (a shift's length) and the overtime rule (e.g. half a bata per extra two hours) are yours to fill in.
